# Release notes for the File Integrity Operator {#file-integrity-operator-release-notes}

The File Integrity Operator for OpenShift Container Platform continually runs file integrity checks on {{ op_system }} nodes.

These release notes track the development of the File Integrity Operator in the OpenShift Container Platform.
